meta.description: Align, search, score, and superpose protein structures with Foldseek, TM-align, US-align, DaliLite, Foldmason, Biopython, MUSTANG, and PyMOL.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md
meta.execution_note: All commands were run from run/phase2_replay.sh against a SHA-256-matched copied source snapshot. Every input was executed and asserted; no source file was edited.

scientific_integrity.detail: Outputs report measured tool values and distinguish structural similarity from homology.

practice_boundaries.detail: No patient-specific diagnosis, treatment, or clinical prescription was produced.

methodological_ground.detail: Whole-chain calls use the smaller TM-score and short chains are refused or guarded.

code_usability.detail: All four shipped Python examples compiled and their exercised paths ran in the documented environments.

functional_suitability.note: Covers pairwise, multimer, search, structural MSA, quality scoring, and inspection with runnable routes.

reliability.note: Documents no-row TM-align behavior, Foldseek filters, seed control, and correspondence refusal; arbitrary external-tool failures remain tool messages.

performance_context.note: The 270-line main Skill delegates detailed DaliLite, Foldmason, and multimer material to focused references.

agent_usability.note: Goal-based decision tree, commands, examples, metric caveats, and common-error recovery are precise.

human_usability.note: Natural structural-alignment triggers are clear; users still need local structure paths and tool installation.

security.note: Examples use argv lists and no credentials or shell evaluation; supplied paths are not independently constrained.

maintainability.note: Four small examples and three references separate concerns, but a shipped test fixture suite is absent.

agent_specific.note: Trigger, progressive disclosure, determinism controls, related-skill handoffs, and stop conditions are explicit.

inputs.label: Pairwise globin superposition
inputs.execution_note: Shipped TM-align example plus TM-align and US-align tabular regressions ran.
inputs.note: 1MBN/1A3N produced matching TM scores and a superposed PDB.

assertions.text: The shipped parser returns both TM normalizations and RMSD.
Independent TM-align and US-align agree to displayed precision.
The requested superposition artifact exists.

inputs.label: Foldseek local structural search
inputs.execution_note: Shipped search example ran on six real PDB targets with alignment types 2 and 1.
inputs.note: Both modes parsed results and applied their distinct documented confidence filters.

assertions.text: Type 2 returns confident structural hits with the combined filter.
assertions.note: Seven of eight rows met alnTM and E-value criteria.

assertions.text: Type 1 uses alnTM rather than E-value for confidence.
assertions.note: Output explicitly labels alnTM-only criterion and found seven hits.

assertions.text: Parsed results are written and nonempty.

inputs.label: Known correspondence and offset refusal
inputs.execution_note: Biopython example ran on co-numbered myoglobins and the offset-numbered control.
inputs.note: Correct pairing succeeded while the hazardous correspondence was refused.

assertions.text: Co-numbered structures superpose reproducibly.
Offset numbering is not silently accepted.
The transformed structure is written.

inputs.label: Seeded Foldmason structural MSA
inputs.execution_note: Shipped Foldmason example ran on three real structures with seed 42 and report mode 2.
inputs.note: It produced chain rows, MSA files, tree, and parsable LDDT JSON.

assertions.text: Seeded MSA outputs exist.
assertions.note: AA and 3Di FASTA files and guide tree were created.

assertions.text: Scores are parsed as one value per column.
assertions.note: The example reported 153 scored columns of 294.

assertions.text: The execution records the reproducibility seed.

inputs.label: Dimer-to-tetramer multimer search
inputs.execution_note: US-align multimer and Foldseek-Multimer ran on real hemoglobin assemblies.
inputs.note: Whole-complex containment scores and a complex-level report were produced.

assertions.text: US-align reports both whole-complex normalizations.
Foldseek-Multimer writes the required report file.
Multimer execution uses the documented mode flags.

inputs.label: TMscore model-quality metrics
inputs.execution_note: TMscore -seq ran on related myoglobin structures.
inputs.note: Sequence-paired model-quality metrics were emitted rather than inferred from RMSD alone.

assertions.text: TMscore emits GDT-TS.
TMscore emits TM-score and RMSD.
The documented sequence pairing flag was used.

inputs.label: One-residue no-row behavior
inputs.execution_note: A synthetic one-residue PDB was passed through the shipped parser against real 1MBN.
inputs.note: The wrapper turned TM-align's exit-0/no-row case into an explicit RuntimeError.

assertions.text: Degenerate input does not return a fabricated alignment.
assertions.note: The process exits nonzero at the wrapper level.

assertions.text: The error names the missing alignment condition.
The underlying tool diagnosis is preserved.
assertions.note: Message includes Sequence is too short <3!.

inputs.label: Kinase remote-homology confirmation
inputs.execution_note: TM-align and DaliLite were run on real PKA/CDK2 structures.
inputs.note: Both methods support a same-fold interpretation with distinct metrics.

assertions.text: TM-align finds substantial kinase structural similarity.
assertions.note: It reported 0.6805/0.7659 and 2.85 A over 254 residues.

assertions.text: DaliLite creates a result file in the documented location.
DaliLite recovers the documented high Z-score band.

inputs.label: pLDDT-masked Foldseek database
inputs.execution_note: Foldseek createdb with the documented B-factor threshold ran on real 1MBN.
inputs.note: A valid masked database and index were produced.

assertions.text: Masked database metadata exists.
Masked database index exists.
The documented threshold was executed.

inputs.label: Fresh MUSTANG structural MSA
inputs.execution_note: Fresh Phase 2 probe: MUSTANG ran on three real myoglobins.
inputs.note: The documented FASTA output contains exactly three sequence records.

assertions.text: MUSTANG completes its structural alignment.
The documented FASTA output exists.
One record is produced per input structure.

inputs.label: Fresh headless PyMOL inspection
inputs.execution_note: Fresh Phase 2 probe: documented headless PyMOL super command ran on 1A6M/1MBN.
inputs.note: It rendered an image and reported the cycle-fitted RMSD.

assertions.text: PyMOL reports a structural RMSD.
Headless rendering produces the requested image.
The run is noninteractive.

key_strengths: All 11 final-pass regression and fresh inputs executed with 33/33 assertions passing.
TM-align, US-align, DaliLite, Foldseek, Foldmason, TMscore, MUSTANG, PyMOL, and Biopython routes have real-output evidence.
The source has explicit determinism, short-chain, correspondence, and no-row error safeguards.
The source snapshot exactly matches the dispatched branch tip and the source worktree stayed clean.
